messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In case of an overdose, get medical help.
In case of an overdose, contact a live Poison Center expert right away.
The Poison Center expert can be reached at 1-800-222-1222.
Advice is also available online at poisonhelp.org.
Triplet: ["Poison Center expert", "has online advice available at", "poisonhelp.org"]

The relation 'has online advice available at' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity provides access to online advice or resources available at the website specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has information page': The subject entity has an information page specified by the object entity.
B. 'is for': The subject entity is specifically applicable or relevant to the object entity.
C. 'is a': The subject entity is categorized as the object entity.
D. 'include': The object entity is a type or example of the subject entity.
E. 'is one of most widely prescribed': The subject entity is among the most commonly prescribed entities of the type specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
